author: Alexandria Vaughn
text: I contacted Stiffler’s plumbing due a leaking faucet in our upstairs bathroom, and a leak in our kitchen sink. Matthew came within about 3 hours. He was able to assess and fix everything for a reasonable price. Very respectful and pleasant when my 4 year old wanted to “help.” I would recommend based on communication, reasonable prices and promptness, but especially the kindness he showed my son.

author: Michael Kiser
text: The technician was very polite and professional. He assessed my issue checked for water damage and fixed the problem on the spot. I called them and they came out the same day too. Very happy with the service will go to them again for sure.

author: Jay Bakenhaus
text: Ryan and Matthew at Stifflers came and set  my new waste water pipes to my new building yesterday.  They gave me by far the best price, and they did by far the best job that my family has ever done by a plumbing company. I would most definitely highly recommend them. They are not only the best professionally but courteous,  respectful, and the nicest people. Thank you, Ryan and Matthew!!! If we ever have any problems in the future, we will most definitely be calling them!!

author: Q W
text: Very impressed with the service received. I called one morning due to water heater leak from t&p valve. I was told that a technician would be dispatched that afternoon. I received a text at 1:15 pm that technician would arrive between 1:30-3:30 pm. Matthew arrived exactly at 1:30 pm to assess the problem and it was recommended to replace it due to the age of the water heater. Matthew had the old water heater and the new water heater installed in less time than estimated. The new water heater has been a true upgrade for consistent hot water. I am very thankful that I took a chance and made the call. I will definitely recommend Stiffler’s to anyone needing plumbing services.

author: Stacey Hoffman
text:
Ryan and Matthew were personable and professional.
They went out of their way to get the materials needed. The work was completed efficiently and they cleaned up afterwards. I highly recommend them for plumbing services.
